description: Storyloft: The AI-Native Writing App for Authors Storyloft is a modern, AI-native writing app for authors designed to take your book from first draft to final publication in one seamless platform. Instead of juggling multiple tools, Storyloft combines writing, editing, formatting, and publishing into a single workflow built specifically for long-form content. AI Writing That Understands Your Manuscript At the core of Storyloft is Eddy, a manuscript-aware AI that reads your work before it respond
